verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: On account of her faith and hospitality, Rahab the harlot was saved.
verses.modernizedText: On account of her faith and hospitality, Rahab the harlot was saved.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For when spies were sent by Joshua, the son of Nun, to Jericho, the king of the country ascertained that they were come to spy out their land, and sent men to seize them, in order that, when taken, they might be put to death.
verses.modernizedText: For when spies were sent by Joshua, the son of Nun, to Jericho, the king of the country learned that they had come to spy out their land, and sent men to seize them, so that, when captured, they might be put to death.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: But the hospitable Rahab receiving them, concealed them on the roof of her house under some stalks of flax.
verses.modernizedText: But the hospitable Rahab received them and concealed them on the roof of her house under some stalks of flax.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And when the men sent by the king arrived and said, “There came men unto thee who are to spy out our land; bring them forth, for so the king commands,” she answered them, “The two men whom ye seek came unto me, but quickly departed again and are gone,” thus not discovering the spies to them.
verses.modernizedText: And when the men sent by the king arrived and said, “There came men to you who are to spy out our land; bring them forth, for so the king commands,” she answered them, “The two men whom you seek came to me, but quickly departed again and are gone,” thus not discovering the spies to them.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Then she said to the men, “I know assuredly that the Lord your God hath given you this city, for the fear and dread of you have fallen on its inhabitants.
verses.modernizedText: Then she said to the men, “I know for certain that the Lord your God has given you this city, for the fear and dread of you have fallen on its inhabitants.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: When therefore ye shall have taken it, keep ye me and the house of my father in safety.”
verses.modernizedText: When, therefore, you have taken it, keep me and the house of my father in safety.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And they said to her, “It shall be as thou hast spoken to us.
verses.modernizedText: And they said to her, “It shall be as you have spoken to us.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: As soon, therefore, as thou knowest that we are at hand, thou shalt gather all thy family under thy roof, and they shall be preserved, but all that are found outside of thy dwelling shall perish.”
verses.modernizedText: As soon, therefore, as you know that we are nearby, you shall gather all your family under your roof, and they shall be preserved, but all that are found outside of your dwelling shall perish.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Moreover, they gave her a sign to this effect, that she should hang forth from her house a scarlet thread.
verses.modernizedText: Moreover, they gave her a sign to this effect, that she should hang from her house a scarlet thread.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And thus they made it manifest that redemption should flow through the blood of the Lord to all them that believe and hope in God.
verses.modernizedText: And thus they made it manifest that redemption should flow through the blood of the Lord to all who believe and hope in God.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Ye see, beloved, that there was not only faith, but prophecy, in this woman.
verses.modernizedText: You see, beloved, that there was not only faith, but prophecy, in this woman.
